body.name: total cross-fitted estimator and variance estimator
body.construction: Split the indices deterministically into two folds, learn \(\widehat\eta_{-k(i)}\) by def:endpoint-learning-handle on the opposite fold, set \(W_i:=\psi_1(\widehat\eta_{-k(i)};O_i)-\psi_0(\widehat\eta_{-k(i)};O_i)\), and define \(\widehat\theta:=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nW_i\) and \(\widehat V:=\max\{n^{-1},n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n(W_i-\widehat\theta)^2\}\); use the fixed values \(0\) and \(1\) for \(\widehat\theta\) and \(\widehat V\), respectively, when \(n<4\) or the observed sample lies outside its declared support.
